rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for a written or emailed booking confirmation.

example.english: I received the hotel's booking confirmation, so I can relax.
example.traditional: 我收到酒店寄嚟嘅確認信，可以放心喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sau1 dou2 zau2 dim3 gei3 lei4 ge3 kok3 jan6 seon3 ho2 ji5 fong3 sam1 laa3

rows.note: Use this for general proof that something is true or has happened, rather than for a booking notice.

example.english: This photo is confirmation that they have been to Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 呢張相就係佢去過香港嘅證明。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 soeng2 zau6 hai6 keoi5 heoi3 gwo3 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 zing3 ming4

rows.note: Use this specifically for the Christian ceremony of confirmation.

example.english: They will receive confirmation next month.
example.traditional: 佢下個月會接受堅振禮。
example.jyutping: keoi5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 zip3 sau6 gin1 zan3 lai5
